A labelled credential whose two halves arrive in separate chunks is then scanned as two independent regions, neither of which matches the rule on its own, and the complete key lands in the dream log byte-for-byte — defect WD-SINK-CHUNK-BRAIN-STDOUT. The revert is spelled with `createStreamRedactor` rather than `redactOnly` because AC1 removes `redactOnly` from this file entirely, and a ReferenceError would redden the probe for the wrong reason instead of as an assertion.
